cmd: pnpm run check-types && VITEST_MAX_THREADS=6 pnpm run test:unit

testChange.reason: This change IS a test change and nothing else: eleven bare settle() waits in src/extension.worktreeAssembly.test.ts become settleUntil naming the LAST observable each test asserts on. No assertion is removed, weakened, or made conditional — settleUntil observes the condition or throws, so it cannot turn an absent call into a pass. A wait followed only by a negative assertion is deliberately left bare, since waiting cannot establish that nothing happened.
